sections.title: The irrationality measure of π is at most 7.101862832357
sections.abstract: The paper gives an explicit upper bound μ(π) < 7.101862832357 using a parameterized auxiliary-function calculation.
sections.claimed_result: The author claims that the irrationality measure of π is at most 7.101862832357.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: The claim concerns the irrationality measure of π and depends on an explicitly constructed admissible parameter choice and auxiliary functions.

sections.title: A new proof that more than 2/3 of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function are simple and on the critical line
sections.abstract: A new proof of large quantitative proportions of simple zeta zeros and zeros on the critical line.
sections.claimed_result: The author claims more than two-thirds of nontrivial zeros are simple and on the critical line, with additional stated percentages.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function under the analytic conventions of the paper.
sections.caveat: Not the Riemann hypothesis; proof requires specialist review.

sections.title: Universal norms and de Rham representations
sections.abstract: The note argues that computing universal norms in Iwasawa cohomology for the p-adic cyclotomic extension implies the corresponding result for a broader class of de Rham representations.
sections.claimed_result: The author claims that the cyclotomic universal-norm computation implies the same result for de Rham representations.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Iwasawa cohomology, p-adic cyclotomic extensions, and de Rham representations.
